name: Hoka no Otoko no Seieki de Harande mo Ii Desu ka...? 2 - Osanaku Mieru Karada wa, Sude ni Otoko no Aji o Shitteita
original_name: 他の男の精液で孕んでもいいですか…？2 幼く見えるカラダは、既に男の味を知っていた
source: Hero and the heroine are childhood friends that go to school together. One day she confesses her love and they become a couple. However, he is not the only guy interested in her, and a certain day...
translation: 男主角和女主角是一起上学的儿时好友。有一天，她表白了自己的爱情，他们成为了情侣。然而，他并不是唯一对她感兴趣的男人，有一天……
